ScrollAreaRoot.description: Holds the scroll state and shares it with the parts. Position the scrollbars against it (give it `position: relative`).

props.overflowEdgeThreshold: How far from an edge, in pixels, the content must be scrolled before that edge's `data-overflow-*` attribute appears.

dataAttributes.data-has-overflow-x: Present while the content is wider than the viewport.
dataAttributes.data-has-overflow-y: Present while the content is taller than the viewport.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-x-start: Present while the content is scrolled more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels from its left edge.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-x-end: Present while there is more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels of content beyond the right edge.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-y-start: Present while the content is scrolled more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels from its top.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-y-end: Present while there is more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels of content below the bottom edge.
dataAttributes.data-scrolling: Present while the viewport scrolls on either axis, and for 500ms after.

cssVariables.--scroll-area-corner-width: The corner's width: the vertical scrollbar's thickness while both scrollbars are shown, else `0px`.
cssVariables.--scroll-area-corner-height: The corner's height: the horizontal scrollbar's thickness while both scrollbars are shown, else `0px`.

ScrollAreaViewport.description: The element that scrolls: a native scroll container (`overflow: scroll`) whose own scrollbars are hidden with `scrollbar-width: none`. It takes focus (`tabindex="0"`) while its content overflows, so the keyboard can scroll it. Give it the root's size.

dataAttributes.data-has-overflow-x: Present while the content is wider than the viewport.
dataAttributes.data-has-overflow-y: Present while the content is taller than the viewport.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-x-start: Present while the content is scrolled more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels from its left edge.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-x-end: Present while there is more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels of content beyond the right edge.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-y-start: Present while the content is scrolled more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels from its top.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-y-end: Present while there is more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels of content below the bottom edge.
dataAttributes.data-scrolling: Present while the viewport scrolls on either axis, and for 500ms after.

cssVariables.--scroll-area-overflow-x-start: How far the content is scrolled from its left edge, in pixels.
cssVariables.--scroll-area-overflow-x-end: How much content is beyond the right edge, in pixels.
cssVariables.--scroll-area-overflow-y-start: How far the content is scrolled from its top, in pixels.
cssVariables.--scroll-area-overflow-y-end: How much content is below the bottom edge, in pixels.

ScrollAreaContent.description: Wraps the content inside the viewport. It is at least as wide as what it holds (`min-width: fit-content`), which is how horizontal overflow is measured.

dataAttributes.data-has-overflow-x: Present while the content is wider than the viewport.
dataAttributes.data-has-overflow-y: Present while the content is taller than the viewport.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-x-start: Present while the content is scrolled more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels from its left edge.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-x-end: Present while there is more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels of content beyond the right edge.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-y-start: Present while the content is scrolled more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels from its top.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-y-end: Present while there is more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels of content below the bottom edge.

ScrollAreaScrollbar.description: A scrollbar, rendered while its axis overflows. Pressing its track scrolls so the thumb centres on the pointer, and the wheel over it scrolls the viewport. Hidden from assistive technology: the viewport is what scrolls.

props.orientation: Which axis the scrollbar is for.
props.keepMounted: Keep the scrollbar rendered while there is nothing to scroll on its axis.

dataAttributes.data-has-overflow-x: Present while the content is wider than the viewport.
dataAttributes.data-has-overflow-y: Present while the content is taller than the viewport.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-x-start: Present while the content is scrolled more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels from its left edge.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-x-end: Present while there is more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels of content beyond the right edge.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-y-start: Present while the content is scrolled more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels from its top.
dataAttributes.data-overflow-y-end: Present while there is more than `overflowEdgeThreshold` pixels of content below the bottom edge.
dataAttributes.data-hovering: Present while a mouse or pen is over the scroll area.
dataAttributes.data-scrolling: Present while the viewport scrolls on this scrollbar's axis, and for 500ms after.

cssVariables.--scroll-area-thumb-height: On a vertical scrollbar: the thumb's height in pixels, the visible share of the content's height (at least 16px).
cssVariables.--scroll-area-thumb-width: On a horizontal scrollbar: the thumb's width in pixels, the visible share of the content's width (at least 16px).

ScrollAreaThumb.description: The thumb. Its length comes from the scrollbar's `--scroll-area-thumb-height` or `--scroll-area-thumb-width` and its offset is an inline `transform`; drag it to scroll. Give it its thickness.

dataAttributes.data-scrolling: Present while the viewport scrolls on this thumb's axis, and for 500ms after.

ScrollAreaCorner.description: Fills the square where the two scrollbars meet, rendered only while both are. Its width and height are the scrollbars' thickness, set inline; position it in the root's bottom corner.
